title: I Couldn't Be a Good Christian AND a Good Father

top_liked.author: @NoMastersNoMistress
top_liked.text: Can you be a good Christian and a good parent? Short answer: NO.  And just WTF even is a good Christian, anyway? I'm quite certain Darante got as sick of asking that as I did decades ago.
